coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Thirteen attacks run, none landed. Read the scope before recording: this is a measurement, not a closure. Seven of DR-131's eight NT classes remain leftover-design, gates 2 and 3 do not hold, and the row stays OPEN, not eligible in kind, not SATISFIED. Custody is clean: 4081c740 at 0444 unmoved, v1 frozen at 5ee2bb3e, HEAD never left e68cc88, file 08 at the 23cdf039 pin the artifact itself carries, and all four cited digests reproducing. Both of my findings land in full and I verified them against live bytes rather than the disposition table. The G17 harness quotation is now byte-exact including the tail I measured as missing, so all five gate blocks are byte-exact on id, claim and harness where four of five were before, and the reason text was extended to engage the newly quoted corpus rather than to work around it. NT-4 took the branch I named: its gate, harness and owner fields are all none, its standing is now discharged-by-named-DR-133-classes, and passRides says in terms that DR-131 NT-4 adds no distinct execution obligation and is not itself named at those gates. The summary follows suit, with capableOfRiding emptied and a new discharged field, so seven leftover plus one discharged accounts for all eight contract classes with nothing in an unnamed middle state. Everything carried forward still verifies: all twenty-four NT verbatim fields byte-exact against the contract, the DR-131 evidence cell byte-exact, and a key-set and per-class diff against v1 showing nothing removed, one key added and the other seven classes untouched. I also re-derived the facts NT-4's new category rests on — DR-133 NT-1 and NT-2 named at G21 by D-145, NT-3 at G23 by D-147 — rather than carrying them from my v1 review. Two items are recorded as considered and declined, both of which would have been new demands rather than findings.
